title: fix(cli,runtime): a dangling symlink as the SQLite database's directory is refused at once by os dev and os serve, naming the file and the directory
body:
Fixes #24090

Clause-②: no

Route A, as triage `6228217116` ruled. The two async copies of the bounded walk now call their own package's `makeDirectorySync`: `prepareDevDatabaseDirectory` in `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts`, and `makeSqliteDatabaseDirectory` in `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts`. Each keeps its own error text. The lenient `EEXIST` in `driver-sql`'s `sqlite-database-file.ts` belongs to the driver lane, as the card says, so it is not in this diff.

## What was wrong

Both copies accepted ANY `EEXIST` while they made a missing level. A symbolic link that points nowhere answers `ENOENT` to `stat` and `EEXIST` to `mkdir`. So the copies took it for a directory and returned, and the boot went on until the SQLite driver could not open the file. Each package's `makeDirectorySync` already accepted `EEXIST` only when a directory stands there.

## What changed

- `dev.ts`: `prepareDevDatabaseDirectory` is now synchronous. It calls `makeDirectorySync(directory)` inside its existing `try`, and the wrapper and its message are unchanged. The one caller (`run`, `:624`) drops its `await`, and its `try`, `printError`, remedy line and `exit 1` are unchanged.
- `standalone-stack.ts`: `makeSqliteDatabaseDirectory` is now synchronous. It calls `makeDirectorySync(directory)` and throws the same `SqliteDatabaseDirectoryError`. Both SQLite arms (`sqlite`, `sqlite-wasm`) drop their `await`. They run inside the async `createStandaloneStack`, so a throw is the same rejection as before. The `node:fs/promises` import and `dirname` are no longer used, so they are removed.
- The doc comments of both wrappers, and of both `make-directory.ts` files, stop describing an async copy (comment-only edits in the fold targets).
- Net −37 lines across the four source files. No export changes: neither function is on a package entry.
- `.changeset/24090-db-dir-dangling-symlink.md`: `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/runtime` patch, `Clause-②: no`. Every input whose answer changes already failed the boot.

## Measured at the two doors (Done when, first bullet)

Built CLI (`turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/cli...'`), Node v22.22.0. The scratch projects are outside the repo: `defineStack({})` for `os dev` and `export default {};` for `os serve`. Each run is in its own process group, killed whole at 90 s or on `Press Ctrl+C to stop`. `W` is the scratch directory.

| door | base `b9ac35cbf` | this branch `09c0232dc` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `OS_HOME=W/dl-home os dev --no-watch`, where `W/dl-home/data` is a dangling symlink | exit 1 after 8.3 s: `✗ Plugin com.objectstack.auth failed to start - rollback complete: The database refused to run this query for object 'sys_organization'. …` | exit 1 after 4.8 s, before any serve child: `✗ The default database 'W/dl-home/data/objectstack.db' cannot be created: its directory 'W/dl-home/data' could not be made: EEXIST: file already exists, mkdir 'W/dl-home/data'`, plus the existing remedy line |
| `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:W/dl-db/link/ctl.db os serve --port 0`, where `link` is dangling | exit 1 after 2.7 s: `✗ Plugin package-service failed to start - rollback complete: The database refused to run a raw statement. …` | exit 1 after 2.4 s: `✗ [StandaloneStack] SQLite database file 'W/dl-db/link/ctl.db' cannot be created: its directory 'W/dl-db/link' could not be made: EEXIST: file already exists, mkdir 'W/dl-db/link'` |
| `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:W/dl-mid/link/sub/ctl.db os serve`, a dangling link mid-path | exit 1 after 2.4 s, already named: `… its directory 'W/dl-mid/link/sub' could not be made: ENOENT: …` | exit 1 after 2.4 s: `… could not be made: EEXIST: file already exists, mkdir 'W/dl-mid/link'` |
| `OS_HOME=W/dl-oshome os dev`, where `OS_HOME` itself is dangling | exit 1 after 4.9 s, already named: `… its directory 'W/dl-oshome/data' could not be made: ENOENT: …` | exit 1 after 2.6 s, `EEXIST` |
| CONTROL: `os dev`, a creatable `OS_HOME` two levels deep | banner at 6.3 s | banner at 6.3 s |
| CONTROL: `os serve`, a creatable `file:` path three levels deep | banner at 3.0 s | banner at 3.1 s |

The card's numbers (11.2 s and 5.3 s) are from `b6805ac0f`. Re-measured at this base, the same two failures take 8.3 s and 2.7 s, and their text is unchanged. The two mid-path rows were already immediate named refusals. Only their code changes, from `ENOENT` at the level below the link to `EEXIST` at the link itself. The changeset says so.

## The five unchanged input classes (Done when, second bullet), pinned

| input (the database file's directory) | dev pin (`dev-database-directory.test.ts`) | runtime pin (`standalone-stack-uncreatable-db-directory.test.ts`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| creatable, three levels deep | existing CONTROL | existing CONTROL, both arms |
| already exists | **new** CONTROL | **new** CONTROL, both arms |
| `/proc/MISSING` (`ENOENT`) | existing | existing, both arms |
| through a regular file (`ENOTDIR`) | existing | existing |
| a regular file holds the directory's name (`EEXIST`) | **new** | existing |
| a live symlink to a directory (neighbour CONTROL: only the dangling link is refused) | **new** | **new**, both arms |
| **a dangling symlink as the directory** | **new**: `EEXIST`, names the file and the directory, the link stays a link and nothing is made at its target | **new**, both arms, the same |

The new cases go into each existing pin file as a second `describe`. The existing cases and their assertions are byte-identical. The dev cases share the file's one bounded `tsx` child, because importing `dev.ts` costs about 7 s there. Against the base sources, only the dangling case is red in each file. Every new unchanged-class case is green there too, so the five classes answer as before.

## The event-loop yield (claim H3)

The copies' async walk yielded the loop (1 to 100 turns, measured on #23858). The fold yields 0. Nothing consumes that timing. `prepareDevDatabaseDirectory` has one caller, a sequential step in `os dev`'s `run`. Before it, only the synchronous compile and the signal handlers have run. `makeSqliteDatabaseDirectory` runs inside `createStandaloneStack`, and every production caller awaits that call in sequence: `serve.ts` (about `:2847`), `schema-migrate.ts` (about `:1189`) and `default-host.ts` (`:166`).

## Red at base, and the ablation

Both runs come after the fix was committed (`09c0232dc`), under the verify lock. Both pins import the source (a `tsx` child of `dev.ts`, and a relative import of `standalone-stack.ts`), so no `dist/` is in the path.

- **Red at base.** `git restore --source=b9ac35cbf` put `dev.ts` (blob `de384bf3`) and `standalone-stack.ts` (blob `6ddd65e0`) back to the base sources, working tree only. Runtime pin: 1 failed, 5 passed: `expected a refusal, but createStandaloneStack returned`. Dev pin: 1 failed, 6 passed: `expected 'returned' to be 'rejected'`. Both were restored with `git checkout HEAD`: the blobs equal HEAD (`17fc74e9`, `8b74041b`), `git diff HEAD` is empty and the status is clean.
- **Ablation.** The run used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, once per package. In each `make-directory.ts`, the anchor `if (errorCode(e) !== 'EEXIST' || !isDirectory(each)) throw e;` went from x1 to x0, and the lenient line `if (errorCode(e) !== 'EEXIST') throw e;` went from x0 to x1. Runtime blob: `b6544e2a` to `1c66dc92`. CLI blob: `a4e52da6` to `f1e8b164`. Each package's pin then had exactly its dangling case red: runtime 1 failed, 5 passed; CLI 1 failed, 6 passed. Both were restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, and the anchor back to x1.

## Tests and gates

Exit codes are captured before any pipe, on `09c0232dc`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli run typecheck`: exit 0. The test layer's ledger was unchanged (3 files, 28 errors).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime run typecheck`: exit 0. The test layer's ledger was unchanged (27 files, 190 errors).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --project unit` (the whole unit tier): **exit 0, 310 files, 4,602 tests**. The integration tier is left to CI: no integration file and no spawn entry is touched.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --project local` (the runtime's whole `pnpm test`): **exit 0, 409 files, 6,282 passed, 19 skipped**.
- The two pins plus both walk suites: CLI 2 files and 13 tests, exit 0. Runtime 2 files and 14 tests, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --max-warnings=0` over the six changed `.ts` files: exit 0. The repo-wide run is CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 65 commands (7 paths against the merge base `b9ac35cbf`), run one by one.
  - 62 exited 0 at once.
  - Three first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3), and each was re-run to a reading. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` had found packages without `dist/`. After `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` under the lock, both exited 0: 111 entries across 69 packages load, and 14 configs had none new. `check:type-check-debt` had not got the lock for its closure build. Re-run under the lock, it exited 0: `none above its recorded number`.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: `65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0. The control-byte grep over the 7 files found no hit.

## Acceptance notes

- **The lenient walk left in the repo is the driver lane's.** `makeDatabaseDirectory` in `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sqlite-database-file.ts` (about `:55`, its `EEXIST` arm about `:74`) still accepts any `EEXIST`. The card and the triage leave it to that lane. Both doors measured above now refuse in the host before the driver runs.
  - A declared SQLite datasource reaches the driver's walk without the host. Its doc says so: "A declared SQLite datasource whose directory lay on such a path…".
  - I tried one probe: `os serve` with `defineStack({ datasources: [{ driver: 'sqlite', autoConnect: true, … }] })`. It did not connect the datasource at boot: its creatable CONTROL directory was never made. So reach through that door is NOT MEASURED. Carrier: none.
- `os start` is not in the table. It makes `OS_HOME/data` with the CLI's strict `makeDirectorySync` before it starts a serve child (PR #23979), so a dangling `OS_HOME/data` was already refused there. A dangling link in an `OS_DATABASE_URL` path reaches the same standalone host as `os serve`.
- `origin/main` has gained 4 commits since the base (`6e43b7bc3`). In these packages they touch only `migrate`/`schema-migrate`/`unmanaged-tables` and `runtime/src/domains`, none of this PR's files, and `git merge-tree` is clean. They are not merged in; the queue rebuilds on `main`.
